other_conditions: Applicant must be one of the following: a disabled employee in Chhattisgarh, an employer of persons with disabilities, a voluntary organization working for the benefit of persons with disabilities, or a district in Chhattisgarh providing provisional facilities as outlined in the Disabilities Act
The district award is given to the district that has done the most work for facilities provided under the Act
benefits_summary: Cash awards of ₹5,001 to ₹10,000 along with appreciation certificates (and a shield for the best district) are given to the best disabled employee, employer, voluntary organization, and district for their contributions to disability rehabilitation.
